content.metaTitle: Kanishk Chhabra - Software Development Engineer | Delhi
content.metaDescription: Kanishk Chhabra is a Delhi-based software development engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable React, Next.js, TypeScript, and REST API-driven web applications.
content.openGraphDescription: Portfolio for a full stack developer with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and REST API integration experience.
heroNotes: I build web applications that feel fast, intentional, and reliable. Currently working on wealth management platforms that handle portfolios worth Rs 100 Cr+.
Outside work I've been exploring how AI fits into the design and engineering workflow. Faster prototyping, smarter iteration, less time on the boring parts.
content.aboutHeading: Three years of shipping and still raising the bar.
aboutParagraphs: I'm a software development engineer who genuinely cares about the craft. Clean component architecture, tight performance budgets, API-driven workflows, and UIs that don't just work but feel right. I've spent the last three years building production systems in the wealth and fintech space, working across React, Next.js, TypeScript, and REST APIs on codebases where real money moves every day.

I think the best web application work sits right at the intersection of engineering rigour and design sensibility. Whether I'm refactoring a 200K-line codebase or shipping something new from scratch, I try to bring the same level of care to both.
content.experienceHeading: Built in production. Not just side projects.
content.projectsHeading: Products I've shaped end to end.
content.projectsIntro: Wealth management, retail investing, analytics, and commerce. Built for real users with real stakes.
content.contactIntro: I'm open to the right opportunity. That could be a product-focused software engineering role, a team working on something genuinely interesting, or a freelance project worth putting real effort into. Drop a line and let's talk.

bullets: Led UI development for scalable wealth and investment management features across 5 major React projects.
Collaborated with backend teams to integrate REST APIs, authentication workflows, and secure client-server communication across multiple applications.
Integrated 10+ reusable React components, reducing UI development cycles in upcoming releases.
Maintained and optimized a 200,000+ line codebase, improving performance, maintainability, scalability, and overall application stability.
Participated in code reviews, sprint planning, production deployments, debugging, and end-to-end SDLC activities across multiple product releases.
Developed data-driven dashboards and workflow automation features improving portfolio monitoring, reporting, and user decision-making.
Integrated multiple REST APIs and optimized frontend data-fetching workflows for improved responsiveness and user experience.
Built client-status tracking, role-based access, advisor dashboards, and improved onboarding UX.
Collaborated in Agile Scrum with daily standups, sprint planning, and production releases.
Trained in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, DBMS, SQL, Java, Hibernate, and Spring basics.
Solved 100+ DSA problems, strengthening algorithms and problem-solving skills.
